subject: Accelerated acceptance flow — MAP prototype & 30-day decision rhythm
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novum.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerated acceptance flow — MAP prototype & 30-day decision rhythm

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, I put together a compact MAP prototype that focuses on a 30-day decision rhythm and the minimal technical checkpoints Novum asked to validate. The doc is a lightweight co-edit (linked below) and has three proposed lanes:

- Decision milestones (business, legal, procurement)
- Technical validation (smoke tests, latency/throughput gates)
- Ops & security (data residency, logging, incident playbook)

Can you confirm who on your side should own the procurement lane and whether Novum wants a separate procurement checklist? If yes, we’ll paste a procurement checklist into the MAP and add an owner column.

Next steps I propose:
1) Novum adds owners & quick-risk flags in the doc (this week)
2) Redwood schedules a 30‑minute tech validation call with your infra lead (Tues/Wed)
3) We iterate the MAP and lock the go/no-go milestone for 30 days out

Attached: MAP-Proposal-Template-v2.gdoc (co-edit), Acceptance-Slate.pdf (one‑pager), 30d-decision-rhythm.xlsx (timeline stub).

Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform
From: Elena Torres <elena@novum.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@novum.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerated acceptance flow — MAP prototype & 30-day decision rhythm

Priya —

Appreciate the concise plan and the doc. Quick answers:

- Procurement owner: I’ll loop in Marco (cc’d via procurement alias) but the day-to-day owner will be me for this trial.
- We do want a separate procurement checklist; our legal team has a short list for data processing terms (~5 items) that we’ll paste into the MAP.

A couple of clarifying Qs before we edit:
1) For the technical validation lane, are you proposing a 1‑hour smoke test run or a two‑step (smoke + load) approach?
2) Can we get a short note on rollback/fallback behavior if we hit a latency SLO breach during the test?

I’ll add owners to the doc by EOD and add Marco to procurement if needed.

Thanks —
Elena
Head of Platform & Integrations
Elena Torres | Novum AI
elena@novum.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Accelerated acceptance flow — MAP prototype & 30-day decision rhythm

FYI — forwarding Elena’s note. Quick thoughts for the tech validation lane:

- Start with a 1‑hour smoke run (functionality + correctness on a representative sample). If smoke passes, schedule a short 30m load window at reduced concurrency to check steady-state latency.
- Priya / Jasmine: we should include an explicit fallback row in the MAP that spells out model variant fallback + traffic-shift plan (e.g., route to a smaller quantized variant or different region). I’ll draft that row and add it to the doc.
- Jasmine: can you own scheduling the infra call and loop in an SRE? Suggest Tue 10–11am PT as the first slot.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0148

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference>

Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerated acceptance flow — MAP prototype & 30-day decision rhythm

Elena — thanks for the quick responses and for owning the procurement lane. I made three small updates to the MAP (doc link below):

- Added a fallback row outlining model variant fallback + traffic-shift steps (Ben’s suggestion)
- Added a two-step technical validation plan: 1) 60m smoke (correctness + auth + basic latency), 2) 30m reduced-concurrency load check
- Included a rollback checklist for the test (who toggles routing, who notifies SC/EA, expected SLAs)

Proposed slots for the infra call: Tue 24 Jul 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 25 Jul 11:00–11:30 PT. Jasmine — can you confirm and send the calendar invite with the call agenda?

Doc (please co-edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-MAP-Proposal-Template
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3487

If Novum is comfortable with this rhythm, we’ll aim to lock a go/no‑go milestone 30 days from the tech validation date and keep legal/procurement checkpoints aligned in parallel.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0199
